report.summary_comments: The overall recommendation is to RESUBMIT the detectable underground warning tape material submittal. The most significant issues identified include the failure to provide the Material Source Declaration Form (MSDF) and the non-compliance with pH requirements, where the tape did not remain legible and color fast in soil conditions at pH values of 2.5 to 11.0.
